title: El Mercurio interview: Investment Surprise May Delay Recovery, RPM Inflation-Risk Message Stands
source: el_mercurio (press interview, Q&A, by Jessica Marticorena)
summary: A largely protocol interview after the Q3 GDP drop and the IEF, in which Costa gives few policy clues and repeatedly defers the hard questions (recovery timing, the short-term inflation path, the 2027 growth range) to the December IPoM. What is new is the explicit acknowledgment that demand, especially investment, has been weaker than expected, with no clear signs of a turn, which puts the investment-led 2027 recovery at risk of delay. On inflation she only refers back to the October RPM message on higher risks and takes little comfort from the fuel-price freeze, since its unwinding depends on international oil prices. On the peso she cites the copper slump and the global dollar, downplays the depreciated level as a necessary adjustment variable that absorbs shocks, rules out intervention and shows no discomfort with the daily reserve-purchase program. This is her first entry in the base; it reads as a non-committal hold, between Naudon (19/11) and Céspedes (17/11), with the new information tilting toward weaker activity rather than toward more tightening.

key_quotes.quote: En el informe de septiembre, teníamos en perspectiva que la recuperación sería liderada por la inversión, pero continúa con cifras negativas y todavía no vemos señales claras de recuperación o de cambio de tendencia.
key_quotes.context: On whether the weakness is broader than mining

key_quotes.quote: Si los precios están por sobre el umbral que están poniendo como techo, cuando el techo se elimine va a haber que traspasar.
key_quotes.context: On whether the fuel-price freeze only delays inflation pressures

key_quotes.quote: Lo que el dólar está reflejando son factores globales que enfrenta la economía. Ese es un ajuste necesario para la economía.
key_quotes.context: Asked whether Chile must get used to a dollar above 1,000 pesos

key_quotes.quote: Eso lo vamos a revisar en diciembre, porque vamos a tener más información, más antecedentes y ahí vamos a hacer un diagnóstico más completo de corto y de mediano plazo
key_quotes.context: Asked whether the recovery could be delayed or more gradual; typical of the deferrals to the December IPoM
